subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept same-agent owner-scoped live orphan transcript hits in `memory_search` when session visibility permits, or should that behavior wait for the broader default-off private recall setting?
rationale: The remaining gap is source-reproducible, but the fix changes a private transcript visibility boundary and overlaps an active maintainer product direction, so automation should not choose the policy alone.

options.title: Land Targeted Fix First
options.body: Accept a narrow same-agent live-orphan fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261 while keeping broader private recall as a separate default-off product setting.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recall
options.body: Pause the narrow bug fix and resolve the behavior only through the remember-across-private-conversations product surface.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed
options.body: Require a session-store entry before surfacing live transcript hits, preserving the strict current boundary but leaving the reported gateway recall gap unresolved.

recommendation.title: Land Targeted Fix First
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow same-agent live-orphan fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261 while keeping broader private recall as a separate default-off product setting.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active broader private-recall direction that needs to align with the targeted session-memory visibility fix.
